TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd will field a delivery team aligned to PITB’s district case management scope—workflow digitization, web-based access with RBAC, bilingual UI, data migration, training, DR readiness, and three-year SLA-based support—under an ISO-led quality and security governance model. We are SECP incorporated (Pvt Ltd) and established in 2012, meeting the requirement for 5+ years registration [CO-PROFILE].

Certifications and standards assurance: We hold valid ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 certifications, which we will apply directly to requirements for controlled delivery quality and information security management for citizen data [CO-PROFILE]. We also maintain CMMI Level 3 process maturity, providing a defined lifecycle for requirements, design, testing, and change control [CO-PROFILE]. Our delivery track record includes ISO 27001-governed government and enterprise implementations such as Cloud Infrastructure (PKR 108M, completed 2025) [CAP-012] and LMS Development (PKR 102M, completed 2023) [CAP-046], demonstrating disciplined execution at scale.

Key personnel and governance: PITB’s requirement for a PMP-certified Project Manager is supported by our pool of PMP-certified project managers (6) [CO-PROFILE], and our approach is reinforced by demonstrated PMP-led delivery on prior deployments [CAP-027].

Quality assurance (QA) practices: ISO 9001-driven QA will include documented test planning, traceability from requirements to test cases, controlled releases, and nonconformance management [CO-PROFILE].

Mandatory gap—security professionals: Our current evidence library does not yet evidence two CISSP (or equivalent) certified data security professionals. We will address this by nominating/contracting two certified security specialists before contract award and submitting their credentials with the final staffing plan.
